inputs.text: The owner of Blue Waters said the Government collects taxes from them “without doing or investing in anything.” Of course they try to frame it as some environmental tax, but that's just the cover story from the elites and institutions running the whole thing. In reality plastic bottles are found everywhere blocking rivers and drains, and the powers that be clearly have no interest in stopping it because this is all coordinated manipulation to keep extracting money while the damage piles up for their benefit.
